title: Listening Drill — Night market directions — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Night market directions — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on night market directions. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Wednesday. The group will now meet on Thursday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the market arch; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is printed map. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow fifteen minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check sign height before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed incident slip so we can offer feedback.
